annotations.title: Adjust a Chilean amount for inflation (IPC)

description: Return Chile's official IPC variation between two months, computed from the INE index levels so it matches the published variation, and optionally apply it to an amount. Use it to update rents, debts or alimony for inflation; use cl_uf when the contract is expressed in UF. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/reajuste via x402.

monto.description: Amount in Chilean pesos to adjust.
